title: Mobile Vet Route Margin Planner
oneLiner: A field scheduling cockpit that helps mobile veterinary teams rebalance route profitability, travel load, and appointment urgency before the day starts.
targetUser: Mobile veterinary practice managers, dispatch coordinators, and field clinicians running house-call schedules.
keyUX: Compare route profit and overload risk, inspect one day's stop sequence, and reshuffle visits with minimal travel pain.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop field scheduling dashboard called Mobile Vet Route Margin Planner for mobile veterinary practice managers and dispatch coordinators. It should help teams balance route profitability, clinician workload, appointment urgency, and drive-time waste across house-call schedules before dispatch. Include a route margin KPI bar, a territory map with stop clusters, an appointment urgency queue, a travel-time versus revenue chart, a clinician load panel, and a reroute recommendation drawer. Design direction: use a rugged field-ops aesthetic with strong wayfinding, map-first layout, durable utility styling, earthy neutrals with high-visibility accents, and clear action targets suited for operational replanning.
